audit.scope: Exact saved-weight known-MDP audit; all available states/actions and full paths, no optimizer/training replay. Old finite economics reused through accepted hashes. Process event sequence and recorded counters checked; not independently authenticated wall clocks or continuous peak memory.

resources.scope: Separate Node process RSS reported at completed proposal milestones, with Windows parent current-working-set sample upon receipt; approximately paired sum is not simultaneous/continuous peak or unique physical memory. Shared pages can be counted twice. Case elapsed duration includes startup/input/solver/certificate/termination overhead.

defaultSelection.scope: Presentation choice before new strategic outcomes, not a scientific factor or whole-project preregistration; retain even if zero, negative or unavailable.

meta.statisticalScope: 48 dependent seller/controller counterfactuals from 12 whole-market seeds in one targeted stratum. Descriptive exact counts/medians/seed means and paired differences; no confidence intervals, p-values or market-population inference.
meta.controllerComparisonScope: Separately trained policy pairs differ in clocks, legal experiences and phase capacities. Paired seed comparison is not a clock-only causal intervention, cap-frequency causal effect or unrestricted capability control.
meta.informationScope: White-box response audit: the optimizer knows the complete frozen partner lookup, legal masks and saved rewards. This is not a competitor learning a response from limited observations.
meta.valueScope: Mathematical discount19/20 and saved numerical rewards; raw achieved response, baseline fallback, possible best bound and remaining optimizer gap remain distinct.
meta.welfareScope: Secondary eventual-cycle customer-benefit mean, excluding transient; not discounted welfare, a finite-prefix guarantee or a learning effect.
meta.displayScope: No Q floats, browser optimization, new learning or language-model/chat/API seller calls. Manual execution starts at saved history/NEXT phase; its earned finite discounted score is separate from infinite audited policy values. A new manual segment is not an original activation-prefix welfare certificate.
